gospel-pattern.title: Chimanyorio chi Endabari
gospel-pattern.summary: Gocha motogete kubw’akoboirwe ka Kristo, kurombwe, na okuhunyangwa, na iritwa rigwati kubona ya omorweti.

0.title: Ibia bya endabari
0.explanation: Paul atige ogotebesia Abakorintho endabari yabeire nabeire: Kristo oririre kwa ebiyago byachie ne Ndikorania, arerite, aonywete omotogote. Ebio nigo ebirori byogotobora byetabereire motegoria ya Abakristo, tibainyora esemani ya obwang’ani bw’esioyo. Chigoti chiasatira omonyaririe omonyaririe chintike gochia. Ekembe, kobatizwa, na obwaminto obokarauchero bine ritondo omonto Kristo oreire, arerite, na aonywete omotogote.
0.hook: Paul aiogora ebia bya endabari: Kristo oreire, arerite, na aonywete omotogote. Luka agotonya konya riokore ritindo omonyaririe okora kio.

1.title: Kristo omonyore aasaigwa ritindo
1.explanation: Yeso omonyore atutung’a Tegania niba Nyandikotani yaisonire oborwati bwake na okuhunyangwa, na amobora ng’akembei na okobwatia ebiyago bitongane nigo ekembe na orwanchera y’ebibi biokobwatia eringana gochina ye. Endabari ni gochia gokobokia Kristo kogotie okonyana na ritindo. Ritindo rino ritereriye ogotiera bwanyamura bw’ebiarwe, tire ogoreti okora ebinde bireire obosikaigo bw’esia. Ebiko ebiiri ko Acts amaitikore amairirie abatasi baYeso bakogora ritindo rino engwe mogokorania eria Jerusalem gotang’ania.
1.hook: Yeso arigana oborwati bwake na okuhunyangwa na ekembe na kobwatia kw’ebibi gogotiegwa ekerore kia. Acts 2 agotonya konyora chetekwa abatasi bainesete gotora ritindo rino riokobwatia.

2.title: Ritindo rigwati ria abatasi
2.explanation: Peter aing’anisia orwanchera Kristo oreire, aonywete na akorogoreire, abain’ebi abateikira bamusaba okogora? Atinyaire ekembe na kobatizwa eringana na Yeso kwatina orio obokwetera Ebisumi (Holy Ghost). Ekimani kia Apostolic Oneness kikoonyorera ritindo rino gochia ebia by’endabari: okwerokora ebibi, kwonikana na Kristo kubw’okubatizwa, na kogokora obwaminto obokarauchero ngwenyora Ebisumi. Ebire banoire Actsi na baruwa za Paul, tire kobekerwa ni etaraiti eti ekwanania tatu riokobwatia esi verse rino.
2.hook: Ekembe, kobatizwa, na kogererwa Ebisumi nibyo biokora ritindo riboirwe. Waroma agotonya konyora kobatizwa kąnenda kobia Kristo orerie na arerie.

3.title: Obori na okuhunyangwa byakora
3.explanation: Paul agendera aborumani ababatiziwe Kristo bate Irishia orwanchera bokere okoroke oborwati bwake na okuhunyangwa ngata ointenge otogete oboraminto obokarauchero. Bisio biomoka okwa kobwira ekobatizwa na Kristo rorerie, kuhunyangwa, na okuhunyangwa bwake. Tibionyekana kobatizwa ki sarika, tirio omw’egento irite Kristo. Esababu ni oboraminto obokorigeria okwa okoyang’ania kokwana motogete wa Kristo omonyore.
3.hook: Kobatizwa kwetekania abainyora na Kristo orerie na arerie. Waroma 8 agotonya kokonya kwabere okorige Resurrection omonto okorokwa Ebisumi bira.

4.title: Oboraminto obokarauchero kw’Ebisumi
4.explanation: Paul areba Ebisumi obwe oreire Kristo omonyore okonyorera abainyora, na ng’ama omonto aitigete Ebisumi bwake, Nyasae agobotiera orwanchera boke motogete bw’Ebisumi buke. Oborokwa tire echirango chi Kristo omonyore ne gihebe, chionyekana kw’egento omonyaririe ne chikwawera enchera yokorigeria. Ensiya, oboraminto bw’Ebisumi nobwasisira okoge. Ekorigeria ekogotobora na oborokwa oboyang’aniwe.
4.hook: Endabari tire ichinu chiokwerera, ni okorigeria okogotobora omonto abere no gwera Faith. Ekegera keyio, ching’ana: obokebeki, Faith, na ritindo okokorana chionde.

faith-grace-and-obedience.title: Enyomba, Enyamasani, na Koretegorieka
faith-grace-and-obedience.summary: Gotora ekemorogo ekorwatechi obokobwani gotanya enyamasani na gokoretoriaa gototimana enyomba.

0.title: Tandika na enyamasani
0.explanation: Paul aseangira ete okoborwa nigo kibori ch'Omogusii, inganairete enyamasani ekentekeireko enyomba, timabere gose obwatonere bw'abanto oburekwe gokora ogotoba. Ase igoro are naira aira abori abaiseke bagokorana n'ekorokia ya Kristo k'ibori tyreteire ireteinio ebirori biega. Okoretoria b'Apostolic teko kororete nk'egokwa ekororegwa eng'ani. Okobokania, omogorano, na okonyera mogoroba n'Oyaya wa Omwari nigo ikabere gose orwatechi boria ekokanya okoibora kwe Omogusii abakonyene kororoteria eng'ani. Ekokanya geteiria gotimikaga emochi eng'ani: Omogusii nigo oboirora, na okoborwa kw'obosa kwe enyomba nigo gokorete kerigerania aye ekonyone.
0.hook: Paul atandika na enyamasani: okoborwa nigo kibori ch'Omogusii, timabere ya obwatonere bw'abanto. Irio nigo nigo ire obweya, ire enyamasani igoikora abanto barekererie ebirori biega, n'iborio Romans ebisubuya orwatechi enyomba na okoretoria gotochi boria bikoretania.

1.title: Okoretoria kw'enyomba
1.explanation: Paul akwana okobwana kwegeseneti ke k'ekorateta enyomba goibora kw'enyomba imbunge igorora Kristo. Mwene okomanya igoro, enyomba bwari itemeirieye k'egotongwa na ereta re arende rieti richenda okogeire obwatechi. Enyomba enye ekorora Ebisacha na eng'ani ekonyete. Eke teko kowecha okoretoria chi obwatonere bw'okoborwa; esochera ekero ekoretoria che enyomba ni igoikora. Enyamasani nigo ibisokiera enyomba, na enyomba empinge imanyora obobeire kwa Jesu.
1.hook: Paul arorerete korora okoretoria kwe enyomba gose goseganchera okoretoria n'enyomba. Galatians asasire ogo igoikora enyomba ya yang'a, enyomba egokera na oboregani.

2.title: Enyomba eginchora oboregani
2.explanation: Paul akwana kera Kristo, oba okoborera gose okonyera kaigo, ndare ire, enga enyomba egobora echuma ch'oboeregani. Ekonyoke ekerani eng'ani n'ekerefere enyomba na ebirie bisagane. Ekonyoke ire engoesenta engwaniga ekwambere ya chingero ch'obosani gose enyomba egokonya oboregani. Omwanchani tekwendere okogonera engwaniga y'obosani agokiang'ana obwemera Kristo obosete. Paul abwatechi enyomba ekwambere nigo enye igochora amaragerageranio mo obonto bagera abanto.
2.hook: Enyomba y'Eng'ania nigo yakorochora oboregani. James ayakana ebirigyambere, ogoti ekeria enyomba etachorera ebirori bokorania eri yakomore.

3.title: Enyomba etayi
3.explanation: James akwana enyomba etakora ebirori egosirigi, arekerania ekero na omonto onye agosinia obora gose aria akenyera yamwoma echiesa. Oyio nigo akarora egokwana yona kera gose ebikomi n'engechi, ekoretoria gose obosa. Ekero eki nigo goyenya ekobwana kwe Paul ekwana okoborwa n'ekibori ch'Omogusii, tigo ebiriororye. Abesoma abwatechi egento ginene: Paul ayakana obwatonere bwe birori, James ayakana enyomba enya etachoregea ebirori biega.
3.hook: James ayakana enyomba egosirigani gose egorere ekeore. Colossians asira okobokania ekorio kogokania obwatobora bwa faith egokonya baptism.

4.title: Baptism kobwatoborwa
4.explanation: Paul arorete abaiseke egokonyora nigo egosharire n'a Kristo mokora kogokora baptism egokonyera enyomba mogorani n'Omogusii. Ekero kegwa orotera kenea kwe okobokania mokora rituko riabantu gose ogosuboria okore egento. Ebi, nigo enyomba egokora Omogusii oyio oyarere Jesu mokogirwe ebwerania. Irio nigo immersion (Baptism) na enyomba nigo biri ebwatechi gonka nago okobokania tegoti ekirigani ekirogete enyamasani. Amaani n'ekoreteka y'Omogusii nigo egento igonsi egosochera kibori ch'oboborwa.
4.hook: Okobokania timarekane n'enyamasani ochenusirigani ekirogete ekororerania ekoreteka ya Omogusii obwe abanto. Ekeri ekogera gosekerania ekero ekirore gongo: okobokania kwe nyaminto wa Omogusii eng'ani y'Omogusii.

right-hand-of-god.title: Ekeraririe Ria Rianda Y’Omogit’ene
right-hand-of-god.summary: Isomere ekeraririe kia rianda kw’etanda nabweru giogo, gose, okoreta n’obosigani.

0.title: Andiko egokora sembe esiomereire
0.explanation: MoMosese’ko omony’io bwakogenderereria, omwoyo y’Omogit’ene rianda yake ekerarirwe kioboru bwang’ani akaba ekoriragwete abaisiraeli. Kisomu gikoigia emearia omogit’ene n’egererete omogotoro goigete giogo; kiongo kiokorwe kiamosianasiere ekeraririe. Egokora ebegaise yamochereire "rianda" moandikoni. Amaandiko amaateire ko Mesia omoirwa aagenche obosani bw’omoragerio go’Omogit’ene akobwisia ebego na ekeraririe ya bogeke, materyanokerie mo ekenya ekemesereire na ko omochogu bwaryo ereta gose ekenya kegendererete.
0.hook: Exodusi egokora rianda ya Omogit’ene n’ekioria kioboru bwang’ani. Zaburi 118 ekerasia rigererie ese, naye andiko enokobwateka korigereria egokoro bwegesi ekioria.

1.title: Rianda y’Omogit’ene ekorwa
1.explanation: Zaburi egokora koba rianda y’Omogit’ene n’ekerarirwe n’ageture n’ugesigani. Esio ekokorire omogotoro go’Omogit’ene giogo, gotari ekorotwete omorende osietera na rianda eso. Amaandiko agarigokora rigererie ese, gekobatega ebogo, gose, bogeke, n’enyambaria. Kora erinde ekobwateka enyang’aini bwokoreta endarwa egendererete. Kiarieti chisomi chiokoburie ko Zaburi ekerigereria rigererie ese ku Mesia omoirwa.
1.hook: Rianda y’Omogit’ene ekorwa n’ugesigani, nogesimane ko ekeraririe ekiondie kioboru. Zaburi 110 enuniagete rigererie ese mo mesia goitetera bogeke.

2.title: Bogekenene bw’Omomesia
2.explanation: Zaburi 110 erweete Omogit’ene okogosacha omogambi wa Daudi akamwora agende agachama ko rianda yakwe mpaka abaisani bake batekwetikwa. Andiko egokora egosaba omogambi na ogendi arigere nagomotoke. Ekitabu kia Apostolic Oneness kikobwateka ko ogendi arigere Mesia Yesu Kristo, oria ararosa bogeke bwamang’ana na ekeraririe. Rigererie ese no rigereria bogekenene n’obokania. Kitakorugeria gotigeka rigererie ese oboire mo ebo, gose gotora gotasa endarwa ekionde ogosacha bw’okonyi go’Omogit’ene.
2.hook: Zaburi 110 ekaneire Mesia ko rianda y’Omogit’ene mo bogekenene moero. Petero mo pentekositi egokora erende rigererie ese ri Mesia ogotindete Yesu.

3.title: Petero ekoreta bogekenene
3.explanation: Petero egokora ko Omogit’ene amosire Yesu, amokete, nakorire Ekeraririe EkiaMosani (omoyagwa gokyomo). Egokora Zaburi 110 ekosacha rigererie ese ri Mesia ogotindete, akorigereria bogekenene go Yesu nago bogekenene bwi Kristo. Chitabu kia Apostolic Oneness chinagetera bogekenene go Yesu go mokungu na Mesia gokenganane ko engeete go’Omogit’ene irorera mo Yesu. Esio siokorotwete Yesu gotigeka omogit’ene omony’idee. Erinde egokoburana gotora erenda ekeire, ekeraririe, na bogekenene bwakwe agokorwa mwensi yemera.
3.hook: Petero egokora rigererie ese mo ekeraririe, bogekenene, na bogekenene. 1 Korinto ekobwaria eko rigererie ese ri Mesia achetege mo bogekenene na kiabere.

4.title: Obotabore bw’obobogeke burorera ogendo bwabo
4.explanation: Paulo agokora ko Kristo akiabere mbura enyamindo yesi negwe, na kae, obotabore oragendererete Omogit’ene Tata. Andiko egokora ogosacha bogekenene obore n’egokora Omwana akorete bwairandi. Ekitabu kia Apostolic Oneness ekorengera chiang’ani ese ko Yesu ararosa bogekenene mo mokungu Mesia, siogotigeka bo Engeete go’Omogit’ene ekorengererwa mo boranyange go. Kiongo ekorengeria esio mo Paulo ekianyansera, echio nago ogaengerere emagendi egendererete mo Paulo erura go bo Yesu gotigeka Obogekenene bwa Omogit’ene insani.
4.hook: Bogekenene bwore bw’Yesu buchetege go Omogit’ene omony’idee. Enyomba y’Ekeraririe erioko konyora ombasa Yesu aratekeria kwosa akaba Engeete go’Omogit’ene igoire mo nigo igotigeka go nyombe.

jesus-prayers-and-humanity.title: Omonto Yesu Ogotega Buya na Eng’ani Yahwa Omonto
jesus-prayers-and-humanity.summary: Gosigana obwanto bwa Yesu obw’omonto echiek na omonto bwa Isaia ogotwete omonto mukuru bwa Isaia.

0.title: Ching’ria na ogotega (incarnation)
0.explanation: Gabriel aragane ne Mariamu na akamwokia ng’ima ki Yesu n’agondeka bogosira bwa Nyasae, kandi ekeroreti eya Yesu newe eng’ani ya Nyasae. Morogi Yesu aingia boisio moige obw’omonto buya kubw’amachani ya Nyasae, ne Apostolic Oneness, gokobwanchania kwa Yesu kobw’omonto tikogese egento Nyasae eng’oigo ogotanga Betlehemu ama Yesu k’ari nkomari Nyasae buya. Ekeroretese kikaia eng’ani eboigwe ne Gabriel. Emetererie ebisarate eyo ebibaseria korete obochoge bwa Isaia ne Yesu ekyachokia ekitabu chiosi kimwe ch’Oborania.
0.hook: Rukurseencha rwa Luke getangia ogotega: Yesu newe eng’ani egondwe ne Nyasi na ekebere nyaroka. Obokendi obwago nesigana ne ogotoma ko omonto wa Yesu obw’omonto obwonyama nigo obw’atimu?

1.title: Omonto osagarete bosio
1.explanation: Luke anonya Yesu akebanga amagondo okoberege, osio, na ogosubuka kuria Nyasae na arora. Gosumi bw’omonto nobwesicha mong’ina Yesu, na Injili eroreta Yesu atari oyoka okoberege. Ebi orugasokora konya ere Emmaikiria, Ebola yoroba, amanyochia, ama enyamira. Omonto wekire ne Yesu si ogosumi ogosendera amakora ngoina. Nao yio, Ebitaratibo by’Oborania ku Nyasae okomakwaninyana nabyo, tibinomonyweko nebwirirete bw’omonto.
1.hook: Yesu obw’omonto kwego osagarete; Yohana 14 esubata obw’omonto obwonyama ngosacha na omokobo nyasae kiboro Yesu.

2.title: Isaia omotie kindi mwa Yesu
2.explanation: Yesu aragane na ari, Isaia omotia kindi mwa Yesu nonyama bemo. Ogoigwa kwe Yesu n’obw’omonto kesia essa ne baisena Yohana k’oratara Isaia ekebere oyo. Yesu oyoka nonyama kare ekeruchi Isaia enyorora ne ekegwatoka. Ekeroretse eke kerora encho ayio: Tagakanende Yesu todorie obw’omonto obw’enchera, togakanende are oriatikira obw’omonto bwan’ombasa kemanyire ne ekorontoka kobwatwete Isaia. Amagondi ago gomba obwanchania bwo boigwe kwe Yesu.
2.hook: Isaia agotia kindi mwa Yesu ne aenda; ebitaratibo byogoteka buya by’omonto tibinyarore obobisia Nyasae. Gethsemane eyarora omonto osacha chione.

3.title: Omonto ogwa nosacha chione
3.explanation: Gethsemane, Yesu abwira Nyasae abose kobya ariya ya korotokora, kendenyora: ‘ti yio igendetie, nigo chi.”—Enyang’o, amagondo, na obosacha oyo niko, tagakanende ogosenda amagondo. Mu teaching ya Apostolic Oneness ekororetse oba umwana ogosacha chione na amanyire oirwori Nyasae obwanchania, togakanende Yesu ario Nyasae ori nyagokoro. Bitaratibo bigai tenyora Yesu obw’omonto. Kendi, tibibasere ebitaraio eyo ne ekogenderera ebisese boche.
3.hook: Yesu obosacha chione bogendaragia Nyasae. Ba Ebrania etara ebisacha bye Yesu, amagondo, na ogosacha chione kisani ki bw’omonto bwake.

4.title: Amagondo moigwe nyaroka ye omonto
4.explanation: Ba Ebrania erora Yesu abwira amagondo na osacha chione ne engina nyamarera na amagondo ensacha chi enka nyarokani ye omonto, akende omanyire obororera ebosacha. Morimu kwe Yesu bw’omonto bosi, tagakanende ogosenda amagondo. Apostolic Oneness ekorora amagondo nigo obwanchania bwo omonto obwero na Nyasae, nyamara yakore yeso yeso Nyasae ari mwa Yesu. Amagondo ogo tagakanende Yesu kemanyire Nyasae ama gokobwanchana enya.
4.hook: Ba Ebrania etara amagondo kobw’omonto bosi, togabosenda ogotweng’a ama yasoma Nyasae abwanchania. Ba Kolosia ekeboyanga ogotoma kogendera bw’enchera bwose.

5.title: Ogotoma kobwanchania kosichiere
5.explanation: Ogoisire oyang’ana amagondo Yesu, osacha chione, ebisacha, na obororera, saria nyoko Yesu aratati Paul ne Kolosia: obwanchania bwose bwa Nyasae obwomo nonyama nigo. Ogotega (incarnation) togochitema ebitaraio kwe Yesu obw’omonto ama Nyasae bosi. Ebiraio by’omonto bosi togabisende ebitarati bosichiere by’obosacha, na bosichiere ska kasenda obw’omonto. Ebitabo ago gotara okoborera obwanchania bwa Nyasae mw’esenda yaya Yesu.
5.hook: Yesu oyo abwira amagondo obwanchania bose nkwera nonyama. Omonto yakworo Yesu na Nyasae omotie ekworo omobora goikora chisacha bwichu.
